name: Frozen Orange Soufflé
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Mix fruit juice, sugar, and yolks of eggs.
Cook over boiling water until mixture thickens, then add gelatine dissolved in boiling water.
Cool, freeze to a mush, add whip from cream, and continue freezing.
Mould, and serve garnished with candied orange peel and pistachio nuts.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
